propositions: The outbound comment differ computes its dedup key using different decode paths on the local and Jira sides, causing markdown comments to never match their own landed body
Local-side key computation applies a markdown round trip (normalize_outbound) that escapes markdown-active characters and rewrites autolinks, while Jira-side uses adf_to_text without escaping
The send path encodes a decorated body (with HTML comment marker), which triggers markdown_to_adf's fallback to plain text encoding, producing a wire that differs from the local round-trip key
The fix derives the local key by predicting the exact as-sent wire (decorate → fit → encode) and decoding it with the same decoder as the Jira side, eliminating the asymmetry
Under rich_text_cutover="cloud", in-limit markdown comments are re-emitted as duplicate mutations because their local and landed keys diverge
